# GitHub Search Downloader (llms.txt)
> Machine-Readable Context Specification for Autonomous AI Agents

## System Identity & Core Contracts
```toon
{
  "system": {
    "name": "github-search-downloader",
    "version": "0.0.1",
    "runtime": "Python 3.11+",
    "os_target": "Windows 11 / Windows 10 x64",
    "core_capability": "Bypasses GitHub 1,000 search result limit via recursive date-range sharding with parallel cloning, AI relevance filtering, and local SQLite/CSV metadata export."
  },
  "entry_points": {
    "cli": "app.py",
    "gui": "gui_app.py",
    "gui_launcher": "start_gui.bat"
  },
  "security_model": {
    "token_storage": "Windows DPAPI (%LOCALAPPDATA%\\GithubSearchDownloader\\secrets)",
    "token_buffer_capacity": "520+ characters (compatible with variable-length ghs_ tokens)",
    "plaintext_policy": "Zero plaintext tokens in config files or logs"
  },
  "cli_interface": {
    "required_flags": ["--query <str>", "--output <path>"],
    "critical_flags": {
      "--dry-run": "Search and metadata export without git clone",
      "--max-repos <int>": "Maximum repositories to fetch (0 = unlimited)",
      "--incremental": "Skip repo_ids already present in output/metadata/search_*.json",
      "--export-sqlite <path>": "Export metadata to local SQLite database",
      "--export-csv": "Export metadata to CSV format",
      "--graphql-enrich": "Token-backed metadata enrichment (releases, homepage, commit OID)",
      "--deep-relevance": "Score repositories based on README and tree paths",
      "--ai-filter": "Enable 2-phase AI relevance filtering via Ollama or OpenAI-compatible endpoint"
    }
  },
  "verification_commands": {
    "test_suite": "python -m unittest discover -s tests -p \"test_*.py\"",
    "smoke_check": "python app.py --query \"test\" --output \".\\_smoke_output\\probe\" --dry-run --max-repos 5",
    "ast_parity_check": "python scripts/verify_ast_parity.py"
  }
}
```

## Module Map
- `src/github_harvester/service.py`: Central orchestration engine for validation, sharding, AI-filtering, enrichment, and batch download.
- `src/github_harvester/github_api.py`: GitHub REST & GraphQL API client with date-range recursion, rate limit backoff, and tree fetching.
- `src/github_harvester/downloader.py`: Multi-threaded git clone engine with shallow/partial clone profiles and process-tree timeout management (`taskkill /T /F`).
- `src/github_harvester/ai_planner.py`: AI task adapter for Ollama (`/api/generate`, `/api/tags`) and OpenAI-compatible (`/chat/completions`, `/models`).
- `src/github_harvester/secret_store.py`: DPAPI cryptographic token and key manager.
- `src/github_harvester/exporters.py`: SQLite batch exporter (`executemany`) and CSV exporter.
- `src/github_harvester/run_state.py`: Resumable run state tracker (`metadata/run_state_*.json`).
